dct_title_s: United States Minor Outlying Islands - Tropical storm on Aug 26 2026
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001311\_5](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001311) Tropical storm during the period Aug 26 2026-Aug 27 2026 in United States Minor Outlying Islands. The center of the storm was located near latitude 16.7 longitude 162.3. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
